about_the_game:
🕯️ COLD, SILENCE, UNKNOWN.

You wake up in the dark of a forgotten cave, not remembering how you got here. The path to the surface is blocked by ChS - black entities spawned by the very darkness. Explore every corner, interact with ancient mechanisms and uncover the mystery of this place to survive and see the light.

⚒️ A WORLD HOLDING OTHERS' STORIES.

The cave is not empty. You’ll find abandoned work camps with rotting belongings, rusty tools, piles of stone left after collapses. In narrow passages - traces of a hurried past: an overturned wheelbarrow, scattered clamps, someone’s personal items never reclaimed by their owners. These are not props - they are part of a world that lived and died long before you. Squeeze through gaps, clamber over rubble, examine every detail. No artificial puzzles - only environmental logic and natural obstacles.

👤 ONE ENEMY - ONE THREAT.

There is no army of monsters in the game. Only ChS. They are not mere creatures - they are the spawn of the world’s own darkness, and every encounter with them is unique. ChS are aggressive and react to light and sound. This is not scripted jump-scare horror - it’s a living threat where you are the prey. Your salvation is caution and the ability to melt into the dark.

Features of the game:

  • 🎑 Atmosphere without cheap jump-scares - fear is born from silence, the echo of footsteps and the feeling that you are not alone here.

  • 🏚️ Story in the details - why is the cave abandoned? Who or what are the ChS? What happened to those who worked here before? Answers lie in torn notes, the placement of remains, the condition of belongings.

  • 🔦 Light as a risk - the torch in your hand is your only friend. But light attracts ChS, and darkness conceals danger. Balance the urge to see with the fear of being noticed.

  • 🪨 Living environment - rubble, mechanisms, gaps, remnants of structures - all of this can be used to progress further.

  • 🎧 Sound that works on fear - distant rustles, the thud of falling stones, footsteps far away - every element of the soundscape keeps you tense.

🔨 DEVELOPMENT STATUS

The game is in active development. Screenshots on the page reflect the current visual direction of the project, but final graphics and details may change during development. Thank you for following the game!
